grammar.title: be going to 表示将来（计划、打算）
grammar.structure: 主语 + be (am/is/are) + going to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示根据现有证据或意图决定的将来动作 用于表示计划、打算或即将发生的事情

examples.en: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
examples.zh: Debbie Hart打算明天游过英吉利海峡。

examples.en: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock.
examples.zh: 她将在早上五点从法国海岸出发。

grammar.title: will 表示将来（预测、临时决定）
grammar.structure: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示单纯的将来或临时决定 用于表示单纯的将来、预测或临时做出的决定

examples.en: Mr. Hart will be watching her anxiously as she swims.
examples.zh: 当她游泳时，Hart先生将焦虑地注视着她。

examples.en: Debbie will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
examples.zh: Debbie会喝点东西但她不会吃固体食物。

lines.en: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
lines.zh: 哈特准备明天横渡英吉利海峡。

lines.en: Debbie is only eleven years old and she hopes to set up a new world record.
lines.zh: 她打算早上5点钟从法国海岸出发。

lines.en: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
lines.zh: 黛比只有11岁，她希望创一项新的世界纪录。

lines.en: Debbie's father will set out with her in a small boat.
lines.zh: 她是一个游泳能手，很多人认为她一定能成功。

lines.en: Mr.. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
lines.zh: 黛比的父亲将乘一条小船同她一道出发。

lines.en: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
lines.zh: 哈特先生训练她的女儿已经多年了，明天他将焦急地注视着女儿游过这段漫长的距离到达英国。

lines.en: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
lines.zh: 黛比计划每两小时休息一下。

lines.en: She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
lines.zh: 她将喝些饮料，但不吃固体食物。

lines.en: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
lines.zh: 黛比的大部分同学将在英国海岸等候她。

lines.en: Among them will be Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
lines.zh: 他们当中还会有黛比的母亲，她本人还是个姑娘时，也曾横渡过英吉利海峡！

questions.q: What is Debbie going to try to do?
questions.a: She is going to try to swim across the English Channel. She will set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning and she hopes to set up a new world record.
questions.aZh: 她打算尝试横渡英吉利海峡：清晨五点从法国海岸出发，并希望创下新的世界纪录。

questions.q: How old is Debbie, and why do many people feel that she is sure to succeed?
questions.zh: 黛比多大？为什么很多人认为她一定会成功？
questions.a: She is only eleven years old. She is a strong swimmer, and her father has trained her for years, so many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
questions.aZh: 她只有11岁；她是个游泳能手，父亲又训练她多年。

questions.q: What will Mr. Hart do while Debbie is swimming?
questions.zh: 黛比游泳时，哈特先生将做什么？
questions.a: He will set out with her in a small boat and will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
questions.aZh: 他将乘一条小船与她一同出发，并在游往英国的全程中焦急地注视着她。

questions.q: What are Debbie's plans for rests and food during the swim?
questions.zh: 横渡途中黛比对休息和饮食有什么安排？
questions.a: She intends to take short rests every two hours. She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
questions.aZh: 她打算每两小时稍作休息；她会喝些饮料，但不吃任何固体食物。

questions.q: The text ends by mentioning Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl. Why is this detail important?
questions.zh: 课文结尾提到她母亲做姑娘时也横渡过海峡，这个细节有何作用？
questions.a: It shows that swimming the Channel runs in the family: Debbie has her father's training and the example of a mother who has done it herself. That is why people feel she is sure to succeed.
questions.aZh: 说明横渡海峡像是这家人的传统：既有父亲多年的训练，又有母亲亲身成功的榜样，所以人们认为她一定会成功。

translation:
黛比。
哈特准备明天横渡英吉利海峡。
她打算早上5点钟从法国海岸出发。
黛比只有11岁，她希望创一项新的世界纪录。
她是一个游泳能手，很多人认为她一定能成功。
黛比的父亲将乘一条小船同她一道出发。
哈特先生训练她的女儿已经多年了，明天他将焦急地注视着女儿游过这段漫长的距离到达英国。
黛比计划每两小时休息一下。
她将喝些饮料，但不吃固体食物。
黛比的大部分同学将在英国海岸等候她。
他们当中还会有黛比的母亲，她本人还是个姑娘时，也曾横渡过英吉利海峡！
title: Across the Channel
subtitle: 横渡海峡

lead.question: 11岁的黛比明天要横渡英吉利海峡，她凭什么被认为一定能成功？
lead.warmup: 十一岁的女孩要横渡英吉利海峡，听起来像传奇。黛比·哈特明早五点从法国海岸下水，不只想到达英国，还想创下新的世界纪录；父亲训练她多年，将乘小船随行，全程焦急注视。她计划每两小时稍作休息，途中只喝饮料、不吃固体食物。
goals: 听懂课文，理清黛比横渡海峡的时间、路线、补给与家人安排
掌握 set out、set up a record、every two hours、be sure to do、intend to do 等短语
区分 be going to 与 will 表打算，掌握 will be doing 及时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来
lead.summary: 课文以预告口吻讲述11岁的黛比·哈特横渡英吉利海峡的计划：明早五点从法国海岸出发，希望创一项新的世界纪录；她是游泳能手，人们认为她必定成功。父亲乘小船同行并焦急注视；她打算每两小时短暂休息，只喝饮料、不吃固体食物。全文交织使用 be going to、will 与 will be doing 三种将来表达。
lead.tips: be going to 表打算与事先安排，will 表将要发生，will be doing 表将来某时正在进行；as、when 引导的时间状语从句表将来须用一般现在时，如 as she swims。

exercises.q: 填空（每空一词）：Debbie hopes to ____ ____ a new world ____.
exercises.note: set up 创立；record 名词重读首音节。

exercises.q: 汉译英：她打算早上五点钟从法国海岸出发。
exercises.a: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.

exercises.q: 汉译英：她是一个游泳能手，很多人认为她一定能成功。
exercises.a: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
exercises.note: be sure to do 必定会。

exercises.q: 汉译英：哈特先生训练他的女儿已经多年了。
exercises.a: Mr. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
exercises.note: for years 常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: 改错：Tomorrow he will watching her anxiously as she will swim the long distance to England.
exercises.a: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
exercises.note: will be doing；as 从句用一般现在时表将来。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 will be doing 改写 Most of Debbie's school friends will wait for her on the English coast.
exercises.a: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
exercises.note: 将来进行时表将来某时正在进行。

exercises.q: 汉译英：黛比计划每两小时休息一下；她将喝些饮料，但不吃固体食物。
exercises.a: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours. She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.

quiz.q: “她希望创一项新的世界纪录”，其中“创立（纪录）”应译为：
options: set up a new world record
make a new world record
do a new world record
build a new world record
quiz.note: 课文用 set up a world record。

quiz.q: “她打算早上五点钟从法国海岸出发”，下列哪句表达正确？
options: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
She is going to set out from the French coast in five o'clock in the morning.
She is going to set up from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
She is going to set out at the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
quiz.note: set out 出发；时刻用 at。

quiz.q: “很多人认为她一定能成功”，“必定会成功”应译为：
options: she is sure to succeed
she is sure to success
she is sure of succeed
she is sure succeeding

quiz.q: “明天他将焦急地注视着她游过这段漫长的距离到达英国”，正确的一句是：
options: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she will swim the long distance to England.
Tomorrow he will watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
Tomorrow he will have watched her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
quiz.note: as 时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来。

quiz.q: “黛比计划每两小时休息一下”，正确的表达是：
options: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
Debbie intends take short rests every two hours.
Debbie intends to take short rests every two hour.
Debbie intends to take short rests each two hours.

quiz.q: “她将喝些饮料，但不吃固体食物”，正确的一句是：
options: She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
She will have something to drink but she will not eat some solid food.
She will have anything to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
She will have something to drink but she will not eat no solid food.
